commitResults.messageBody: Update AGENTS.md as per instructions.

commitResults.messageTitle: Rename main class: update chatbot name to Thomas
commitResults.messageBody: Rename Duke Chatbot to Thomas for personalisation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add extra greeting: Add simple greeting and farewell
commitResults.messageBody: Application needs a basic greeting and farewell for user interaction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add echo support: echo commands and exit
commitResults.messageBody: Application echos user's inputs and exits when 'bye' given.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add tracking list: Store and list items
commitResults.messageBody:
Application needs to store inputs and tasks and display all added items
when requested.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for tracking tasks: mark tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Application needs user to be able to mark tasks completed.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for tracking: unmark tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Application needs user to unmark previously marked tasks for completion  tracking.

commitResults.messageTitle: Simplfied task representation: Created task class
commitResults.messageBody:
Application used primitive array, making extending of task difficult to
maintain.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support function: Todo, Event, Deadline
commitResults.messageBody:
Application should allow user to add tasks to be done, events with start
and end time, and deadlines with due dates. Application should also
allow users to see what what task is added and total task count.

Add exception handling for all commands to handle cases like empty
description, for deadline missing /by, for event missing /from and /to
or unknown commands.
Application should allow user to delete their tasks.

Application should allow users to view previously added entries in list.
Data should be persistent.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add date format: proper date format
commitResults.messageBody: Application should save date entries in proper format.

Application now supports date/time and checking deadlines/events on a
day.
Split application into proper segments, utilising oop.
Application now splits commands into different abstract classes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reorganise: move project files to packages
commitResults.messageBody:
Application was messy, reorganised and moved the project files into
specific packages.
Application can now run with gradle.

Application now has JUnit tests that cover critical commands that affect
business logic.

commitResults.messageTitle: JUnit test: all non-trivial public methods
commitResults.messageBody:
Application now allows JUnit testing for all non-trivial public methods
in all classes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor: Package app as JAR file.
commitResults.messageBody: Application is now packaged as a JAR file.

commitResults.messageTitle: Find command: implement search of task
commitResults.messageBody: Find command will allow user to look for a task.

Proper JavaDoc documentation is implemented for all non-private methods
in accordance to JavaDoc conventions.

Java sources mix compact methods, incomplete JavaDoc, and inconsistent
import groupings.

That makes reviews harder against the course coding standard.

Let's,
* add missing public constructor and method JavaDoc
* group imports and wrap long lines
* fix JavaDoc form and brace/layout
Resolve merge conflicts.
Resolve merge conflict between master and branch-level-9.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add checkstyle to pick up violations
commitResults.messageBody:
Code currently follows coding standards but does not have a static tool
to enforce it.

Checkstyle can be run to ensure coding standards are enforced.

commitResults.messageTitle: GUI enhancement: Add GUI for user interaction
commitResults.messageBody:
User communicated through CLI and it was usable but not nice to look at.

Now user can have a visual GUI to interact with the chatbot.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix GUI: Welcome message not centered
commitResults.messageBody:
GUI greeting message was not centered.

Aligned the message.
